Trace_001 selected as final. Verification summary:

- Room = L-shaped office, southeasternmost in plan (right of dining room, below the "north_room" with desk/chairs).
- Exterior boundary: outer face east wall x≈611px, outer face south wall y≈876px (confirmed via zoomed corner crop at [580,850,630,900] — outer gray face aligns at x≈611, y≈876).
- North/interior jog boundary at y≈600px (x=403–557) stepping to y≈700px (x=557–611), representative centerline of thin partition, matching the stepped wall visible in [380,560,620,890] crop.
- West boundary: partition centerline x≈403px shared with dining room.
- Door apertures (jamb-to-jamb, arcs/leaves excluded):
 - door_to_north_room: horizontal jog wall at y=700, jambs x=592 and x=557 (visible arc+leaf in [380,560,620,890] crop, right side).
 - door_to_dining_room: vertical partition wall x=403, jambs y=841 and y=874 (confirmed in magnified [380,840,470,895] crop: straight leaf from (403,843) down to hinge (403,878), arc sweeping east into this room — genuine partition door, not the exterior wall).
- No additional door apertures found on the exterior south/east walls of this room (the cyan hatched segments near south wall are windows, no swing arcs observed).

Calibration anchors used: x:[250px→0m, 610px→10m]; y:[150px→20m, 880px→0m], consistent with the 10000mm and 20000mm overall dimension chains shown in the drawing.
